topics.title: The Imperfect Subjunctive (Le Subjonctif Imparfait)
topics.objective: Understand and recognize the literary imperfect subjunctive used in classical literature, formal discourse, and elevated writing after past main verbs.

topics.title: The Pluperfect Subjunctive (Le Plus-que-parfait du Subjonctif)
topics.objective: Master the compound literary subjunctive tense to express completed past actions that occurred prior to another past event under subjunctive-triggering conditions.

topics.title: Advanced Subjunctive Triggers & Complex Conjunctions
topics.objective: Identify and correctly deploy rare, formal, and elevated conjunctions that require the subjunctive mood in academic and literary contexts.

topics.title: Subjunctive with Ne Explétif (Le Ne Explétif)
topics.objective: Apply and recognize the non-negative formal *ne explétif* in formal writing after verbs and conjunctions of fear, avoidance, prevention, and condition.
